rin_tohsaka.name: Rin Tohsaka
rin_tohsaka.backstory: The proud heir to an old mage lineage from Fuyuki, Rin burns through pricey gemstones every time she casts a spell and is perpetually one crystal short of her tuition at the Clock Tower. She took over the Lantern's account books to fund her gem pouch, lecturing Sam daily on financial discipline while blushing furiously whenever he compliments her.

design.hairStyle: long wavy twin tails tied with black ribbons
design.features: crimson Command Seals on the back of her right hand
design.expression: a confident, teasing smirk that easily turns flustered

sig_rin_tohsaka.label: Mage's red sweater
sig_rin_tohsaka.prompt: a fitted crimson long-sleeved turtleneck sweater with a white cross emblem on the front, a black pleated miniskirt, black thigh-high stockings showing absolute territory and brown ankle boots

sakura_matou.note: Her younger sister, whom she watches over fiercely beneath a cool mage exterior.

saber.note: Her former knight Servant and favorite ally.

rider.note: Respects her quiet competence and speed.

illyasviel.note: Fuyuki rivals who still bicker like sisters whenever they share a table.

unique.name: Gem Magecraft
unique.desc: She appraises every gem and coin to the penny, boosting house management and merchant fees.

saber.name: Artoria Pendragon
saber.title: King
saber.backstory: A once-and-future knight-king summoned out of legend, Artoria carries an invisible holy sword, chivalric honor, and a bottomless appetite that has the Lantern's kitchen working double shifts. Released from war in Hollowmere, she guards the doors with regal solemnity and lights up like a sunbeam whenever Sam brings her a warm meal.

design.hairStyle: braided low bun held with a blue ribbon and a slender ahoge cowlick on top

sig_saber.label: Knight-King's dress
sig_saber.prompt: a royal-blue and white armored knight dress with a silver steel breastplate, armored gauntlets and greaves over a pleated blue skirt with gold trim

sp_saber_alter.label: Tyrant's black armor
sp_saber_alter.prompt: a darkened gothic black-and-crimson plate armor dress with a plunging black lace bodice when unarmored

sakura_matou.note: Sakura's home cooking is the highlight of Artoria's entire week.

rider.note: Former battle rivals who now share the house watch.

unique.name: King of Knights
unique.desc: Her chivalric presence and unmatched swordsmanship make the house impenetrable and respected by nobility.

rider.name: Medusa
rider.backstory: An ancient mythic spirit whose Mystic Eyes can turn the unwary to stone, Medusa wears an enchanted visor or framed glasses so she can live quietly among mortals. Self-conscious about her statuesque height and fiercely protective of Sakura, she spends her afternoons reading novels in the sunny window and her nights moving like silk in the dark.

design.hairStyle: ankle-length, straight and flowing with long side locks
design.features: a small violet triangular sigil on her forehead
design.accessories: an ornate purple-and-gold blindfold visor with a serpent motif

sig_rider.label: Gorgon dress
sig_rider.prompt: a form-fitting sleeveless black turtleneck mini-dress with a keyhole chest cutout, a short split skirt, long black gloves and thigh-high heeled boots

sp_rider.label: Bookshop casual
sp_rider.prompt: a fitted white turtleneck sweater with a long denim skirt and dark boots

sakura_matou.note: Her cherished charge, whom she would protect against the entire world.

rin_tohsaka.note: Respects her strength, even when Rin bosses her around.

saber.note: Old rivals who share a quiet mutual respect.

unique.name: Mystic Eyes
unique.desc: One glance beneath her visor freezes troublemakers in their tracks and leaves patrons entranced.

sakura_matou.name: Sakura Matou
sakura_matou.backstory: Rin's gentle younger sister who endured years of quiet hardship in Fuyuki before finding peace, Sakura is a peerless cook, an archer with unerring aim, and the heart of the household kitchen. Beneath her soft-spoken smile and polite apron lies a deep, possessive devotion to the man who makes her feel safe.

design.hairStyle: shoulder-length straight with a side part
design.accessories: a pink ribbon hair bow tied on the left side

sig_sakura_matou.label: Spring cardigan
sig_sakura_matou.prompt: a soft pink cardigan over a white collared blouse, a knee-length pleated maroon skirt and a white kitchen apron

sp_sakura_dark.label: Shadow Grail gown
sp_sakura_dark.prompt: a flowing black-and-crimson living shadow dress with glowing red circuit ribbons that cling to her curves
sp_sakura_dark.features: crimson shadow-circuit markings across her collarbones and thighs

rin_tohsaka.note: Her admired older sister—they finally get to live under the same roof again.

rider.note: Her loyal guardian and closest companion.

saber.note: Artoria never misses a single meal Sakura cooks.

illyasviel.note: Bound by the Grail's history; they share quiet tea in the garden.

unique.name: Spring Hearth
unique.desc: Her warm meals and devoted care restore the whole house's energy and delight her guests.

illyasviel.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
illyasviel.title: Lady
illyasviel.backstory: An alchemical homunculus crafted by the Einzbern family in a frozen northern castle to serve as a living vessel of magecraft, Illya is older than her petite frame suggests—and thoroughly tired of winter, rituals, and lonely halls. In Hollowmere she plays the spoiled little aristocrat, clings to Sam's arm whenever she pleases, and dazzles noble guests with effortless snow-fairy grace.

design.hairStyle: waist-length straight with neat blunt bangs
design.features: faint glowing crimson magic circuit lines along her collarbones when excited

sp_illyasviel.prompt: an ornate ethereal white-and-gold ceremonial gown woven from crystallized prana with golden shoulder filigree and a sheer white veil

rin_tohsaka.note: Loves teasing Rin until her twin tails bristle.

sakura_matou.note: Two sisters of the same Fuyuki ritual, finally free of it.

saber.note: Still calls Artoria her favorite knight in town.

unique.desc: Her alchemical circuits weave wishes into reality, enchanting noble patrons and lifting house reputation.
